verdict.rationale: Quo's authentication docs state that each generated API key grants full API access, so there is no documented way to issue scoped or least-privilege credentials for an agent. Per-key labels, per-key rate limits, and independent key deletion are adjacent key-management features, not permission scoping. The MCP and agent connector material does not describe any credential scoping either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
